name: Recreatives Industries, Inc.
summary: Recreatives Industries, Inc. (RECX) primarily focuses on developing and selling specialized off-road vehicles to both individual consumers and commercial clients across the United States. The company plans to introduce a lineup of recreational and light utility all-terrain vehicles, which it will market under the 'MAX' brand. Founded in 1969 and headquartered in Bradenton, Florida, the organization previously operated under the name Planet Resource Recovery, Inc.
